b.business_name as business_business_name, b.business_address as business_business_address, b.business_explain as business_business_explain, b.business_img as business_business_img, b.order_type_id as business_order_type_id, b.start_price as business_start_price, b.delivery_price as business_delivery_price, b.remarks as business_remarks, b.creator as business_creator, b.updater as business_updater, b.create_time as business_create_time, b.update_time as business_update_time, b.is_deleted as business_deleted,

SELECT f.id, f.create_time, f.update_time, f.creator, f.updater, f.is_deleted, f.food_name, f.food_explain, f.food_img, f.food_price, f.remarks, f.stock, f.category, f.purchase_limit, f.business_id,
b.business_name as business_business_name, b.business_address as business_business_address, b.business_explain as business_business_explain, b.business_img as business_business_img, b.order_type_id as business_order_type_id, b.start_price as business_start_price, b.delivery_price as business_delivery_price, b.remarks as business_remarks, b.creator as business_creator, b.updater as business_updater, b.create_time as business_create_time, b.update_time as business_update_time, b.is_deleted as business_deleted,
u.id as user_id, u.username as user_username, u.create_time as user_create_time, u.creator as user_creator, u.is_deleted as user_deleted, u.update_time as user_update_time, u.updater as user_updater FROM food f
RIGHT JOIN orderdetailet od ON od.food_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN business b ON f.business_id = b.id LEFT JOIN users u ON b.user_id = u.id WHERE f.is_deleted = 0
AND f.business_id = #{businessId}
AND od.order_id = #{orderId}
AND f.shelve_status = 1 AND f.stock > 0 AND b.status = 1 AND b.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food (create_time, creator, is_deleted, update_time, updater, food_explain, food_img, food_name, food_price, remarks, business_id, stock, category, purchase_limit) VALUES (#{createTime}, #{creator}, #{isDeleted}, #{updateTime}, #{updater}, #{foodExplain}, #{foodImg}, #{foodName}, #{foodPrice}, #{remarks}, #{businessId}, COALESCE(#{stock}, 100), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{category}, ''), '其他'), #{purchaseLimit})
